summary: Automate bounded process-improvement incident intake at change finish.

details.problem: Process-improvement incidents were detected and filed through manual triage or post-hoc inspection, creating reliance on human intervention and unbounded or unrecorded incident intake.
details.changes: Automate closed-taxonomy incident intake at lifecycle finish before completion receipt sealing, deduplicate against the open tracker, log verification invalidations, sanitize execution identity, and enforce bounded taxonomy and recursion limits.
details.apply: Adopt the new release package; change finish automatically runs closed-taxonomy incident intake and deduplication without requiring consumer configuration changes.
details.compatibility: No breaking change. Incident taxonomy is closed and governed by the repository owner; deduplication against tracker prevents recursion, and normal lifecycle transitions remain unchanged.
details.notes: Incident intake runs only before sealing completion receipts. Invalidation logs are recorded during verification; intake ignores invalidations if already deduplicated or outside the closed taxonomy.
